description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources used in the AttrEval-Simulation, with five distinct categories represented by colored slices. The largest segment is "ENTITYQUEST," shown in blue, accounting for 26.0% of the total. The second largest is "HOTPOTQA," in red, at 24.2%. "TRIVIAQA," depicted in orange, contributes 22.7%, followed by "POPQA," in yellow, at 21.6%. The smallest segments are "WEBQUESTIO," in teal, at 3.6%, and a very small green slice labeled with 1.9%, which corresponds to the "TRIVIAQA" category in the legend but appears visually as a separate, minor component. Each slice is labeled with its corresponding data source and percentage, with lines connecting the labels to their respective segments. The chart uses a clear color-coding system, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right, with the largest slice positioned at the top.
